courses.adiloProjectTitle: MASTERING THE POWER INTERVIEW FRAMEWORK : KEY STRATEGIES TO IMPRESS EMPLOYERS
courses.title: Mastering the POWER Interview Framework: Job Interview Strategies to Impress Employers
courses.subtitle: Prepare for job interviews with the POWER framework: research the company, sharpen your resume, answer tough questions, practise mock interviews and follow up professionally.
courses.seoDescription: Prepare for job interviews with the POWER framework: research employers, answer tough questions, practise mock interviews and follow up. 17 video lessons.
courses.description:
Walk into your next job interview prepared and confident. This job interview preparation course is built around the POWER Interview Framework, a structured way to prepare, perform and follow up.

Across 17 video lessons you will learn how to read a company's culture before you apply, optimise your resume, prepare for common and difficult questions with effective Q&A techniques, and practise with mock interviews.

You will also see how non-verbal signals shape the interviewer's impression, the key mandatory parts of the interview process, how to ask the interviewer smart questions, and how to write thank-you notes and follow-ups that keep you top of mind.

The course closes with a recap of your top learnings and a plan for keeping your interview skills sharp.
learningOutcomes: Apply the POWER framework to prepare for any job interview
Research a company and its culture before the interview
Prepare clear answers to common interview questions
Practise with mock interviews and improve your delivery
Use confident body language and non-verbal signals
Ask the interviewer thoughtful questions
Write professional thank-you notes and follow-ups
prerequisites: No prior interview training is required.
A device with internet access to watch the video lessons.
targetAudience: Students and fresh graduates preparing for their first job interviews
Job seekers who want a structured way to prepare
Professionals returning to the job market or changing roles

courses.adiloProjectTitle: CRAFTING THE PERFECT RESUME : ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS THAT ATTRACT EMPLOYERS
courses.title: Crafting the Perfect Resume: Resume and Cover Letter Writing That Attracts Employers
courses.subtitle: Learn what hiring managers look for and write a one-page resume, compelling bullet points and a cover letter that gets you noticed.
courses.seoTitle: Resume Writing Course: The Perfect Resume
courses.seoDescription: Write a one-page resume hiring managers notice: compelling bullet points, your unique selling proposition and a cover letter that shows your potential.
courses.description:
Your resume is often your first impression. This resume writing course shows you how to build a resume and cover letter that make hiring managers want to meet you.

In 19 video lessons you will learn the key elements hiring managers look for, how to keep your resume to one page, how to write compelling bullet points and how to present your unique selling proposition. A professional walkthrough of an ideal resume and real resume examples show the principles in practice.

You will then craft a cover letter that reveals your potential, revitalise a dull cover letter, practise confident writing, and prepare for common interview questions so you are ready when your application succeeds.
learningOutcomes: Identify the key elements hiring managers look for in a resume
Write a focused one-page resume
Turn your experience into compelling bullet points
Define and communicate your unique selling proposition
Write a cover letter that shows your potential
Prepare strategic answers to common interview questions
prerequisites: No prior resume writing experience is required.
Your current resume or career details, if you have them, to work on during the course.
targetAudience: Students and graduates writing their first resume
Job seekers who are not getting interview calls
Professionals updating their resume for a new role

courses.subtitle: Prepare for every stage of a job interview: set goals, research the company, dress the part, rehearse your story, handle rejection and follow up.
courses.seoDescription: How to prepare for a job interview step by step: set goals, research the company, dress right, rehearse your story, handle rejection and follow up.
courses.description:
This course takes you through a job interview from start to finish, so you know what to do before, during and after it.

In 17 video lessons you will define clear objectives, research the organisation before the interview, choose the right professional dress code and build connections that support your job search. You will craft a professional narrative that helps you stand out and prepare your mind for the pressure of an interview.

You will then rehearse your interview, learn how to move from interview to offer, sharpen your communication and handle rejection in a way that keeps you moving forward.

keywords.primary: how to prepare for a job interview

learningOutcomes: Set clear objectives for each job interview
Research a company effectively before the interview
Choose an appropriate professional dress code
Craft and rehearse a professional narrative that stands out
Prepare mentally for interview pressure
Handle rejection and plan your next steps
prerequisites: No prior interview training is required.
A device with internet access to watch the video lessons.
targetAudience: Job seekers preparing for upcoming interviews
Students and fresh graduates entering the job market
Anyone who wants a step-by-step interview routine

courses.adiloProjectTitle: HOW TO LAND YOUR FIRST INTERNSHIP
courses.title: How to Land Your First Internship: Resume, LinkedIn, Interviews and Offers
courses.subtitle: Find, apply for and win your first internship, then turn it into a full-time offer.
courses.seoTitle: How to Get Your First Internship
courses.seoDescription: Land your first internship: resume, cover letter and LinkedIn, networking, interview tips, handling rejection and turning an internship into a job.
courses.description:
Getting your first internship can feel impossible without experience. This course gives you a clear, step-by-step plan.

Across 29 video lessons you will set your goals, build self-awareness and explore internship opportunities. You will create an impressive resume, a stand-out cover letter and a strong LinkedIn profile, use networking to find openings and avoid common pitfalls in your search.

You will prepare for and nail the interview, overcome interview anxiety, handle rejections and turn skills gaps to your advantage. Finally, you will learn how to negotiate your offer, make the most of your internship and turn it into a full-time offer.
learningOutcomes: Set clear goals for your internship search
Create an internship-ready resume and cover letter
Build a strong LinkedIn profile and use networking to find openings
Prepare for internship interviews and manage interview anxiety
Handle rejections and present skills gaps positively
Make the most of your internship and work towards a full-time offer
prerequisites: No prior work experience is required.
A device with internet access to watch the video lessons.
targetAudience: College and university students looking for their first internship
Fresh graduates seeking work experience
Career changers exploring internships in a new field

courses.adiloProjectTitle: MASTERING SALARY NEGOTIATIONS : SECURING YOUR WORTH
courses.title: Mastering Salary Negotiation: How to Ask for a Raise and Secure Your Worth
courses.subtitle: Use a four-step negotiation framework, build your value sheet and present a confident case for a salary increase.
courses.seoTitle: Salary Negotiation Course: Ask for a Raise
courses.seoDescription: Learn salary negotiation with a four-step framework: know your market worth, build a value sheet and ask for a raise with confidence. 28 lessons.
courses.description:
Asking for more money is uncomfortable for most people. This salary negotiation course gives you a framework and the preparation to ask with confidence.

Over 28 video lessons you will learn a four-step negotiation framework, how to request a pay rise and how to understand and articulate your value. You will define your goals, build a value sheet, present your case, perfect your pitch and plan your salary increase step by step.

The course also covers closing the gender gap with effective negotiation tactics, assessing your market worth, performance-based increases, how often to raise the topic, when to schedule the discussion, workplace dynamics and winning over your boss. You will learn how to turn disappointment into action and how to set SMART learning goals for your growth.

secondary: how to ask for a raise

learningOutcomes: Apply a four-step framework to salary negotiations
Understand and articulate your value to your employer
Build a value sheet that supports your request
Plan, time and present your case for a salary increase
Assess your market worth before you negotiate
Respond constructively if your request is declined
prerequisites: Useful if you are currently employed or have a job offer to negotiate.
targetAudience: Employees preparing to ask for a raise
Job seekers negotiating a new offer
Professionals who want to be paid what they are worth

courses.title: Mastering Phone Conversations: Confident Professional Phone Communication
courses.subtitle: Speak clearly, listen actively, build rapport and handle cold calls and difficult conversations over the phone with confidence.
courses.seoDescription: Improve your phone communication skills: speak clearly, listen actively, handle cold calls and difficult conversations and build rapport on every call.
courses.description:
Phone calls are still where many business relationships are won or lost. This course helps you handle every call with clarity and confidence.

In 21 video lessons you will learn best practices for clear telephone communication, assess and audit your own phone conversations, and record your calls for self-improvement. You will practise active listening, turn cold calls into engaging conversations, avoid the pitfalls of speakerphones and rehearse your calls.

You will also learn to build rapport with strangers, take useful notes during calls, manage difficult dialogues constructively and decide when a video call works better than a phone call.
learningOutcomes: Communicate clearly and professionally on the phone
Assess and improve your own phone conversations
Use active listening techniques during calls
Turn cold calls into engaging conversations
Build rapport with people you have never met
Handle difficult phone conversations constructively
prerequisites: A phone you can practise with is helpful.
targetAudience: Professionals who make or take business calls
Sales, support and customer-facing teams
Anyone who feels nervous on the phone

courses.subtitle: Overcome speaking anxiety, structure your message, tell stories that land and rehearse on video to present with confidence.
courses.seoDescription: A public speaking course for beginners: manage anxiety, structure key messages, tell stories, rehearse on video and present with confidence.
courses.description:
Public speaking is a skill you can learn. This beginner course takes you from nervous to prepared, one technique at a time.

In 23 video lessons you will learn strategies to move from classroom to stage, use storytelling so your presentations deliver results, reduce anxiety in professional settings and identify the key messages of your talk. You will build confidence for unfamiliar topics and learn how to narrow down your ideas to the strongest concepts.

You will practise with three step-by-step video rehearsals, develop your speaking voice, choose the right tech tools, prepare your key points and learn persuasion techniques used by politicians, ending with how public speaking supports your career.
learningOutcomes: Reduce anxiety when speaking in professional settings
Structure a talk around clear key messages
Use storytelling and examples to engage an audience
Rehearse effectively using video recordings
Use your voice to strengthen your delivery
Prepare persuasive key points for presentations
prerequisites: No public speaking experience is required.
A phone or camera for the video rehearsal exercises is helpful.
targetAudience: Beginners who feel nervous speaking in front of others
Students preparing presentations
Professionals who present at work

courses.adiloProjectTitle: MASTERING THE ART OF WRITING : EFFECTIVE TECHNIQUES FOR BEGINNERS
courses.title: Creative Writing for Beginners: Mastering the Art of Writing
courses.subtitle: Write with confidence: craft strong openings and vivid imagery, find inspiration, build a writing routine, revise like a professional and protect your work.
courses.seoDescription: Creative writing course for beginners: strong openings, vivid imagery, writing prompts, a daily routine, revision techniques and copyright basics.
courses.description:
Discover the craft of writing in this creative writing course for beginners. Across 32 video lessons you will build practical writing skills and a habit that lasts.

You will learn strategies for impactful beginnings, the equipment you need to get started, how to develop word sketches, use sense impressions for vivid imagery, notice nuances and adapt your voice and tone. You will find inspiration outdoors, write productively on the go, write honestly without filters and learn to keep turning up to write.

The course also covers using white space, the differences between fiction and nonfiction, short stories and novels, poetry and prose, and a professional draft–revise–repeat approach. You will work with writing prompts, establish a routine, learn to observe like a writer and understand the difference between plagiarism and inspiration, along with copyright basics to protect your work.

secondary: how to build a writing routine

learningOutcomes: Write impactful openings that draw readers in
Use sense impressions and detail to create vivid imagery
Adapt your voice and tone to different kinds of writing
Build a consistent writing routine
Understand fiction, nonfiction, short stories, novels, poetry and prose
Revise your drafts with a professional approach
Borrow ethically and protect your own work with copyright basics
prerequisites: No prior creative writing experience is required.
A notebook or digital document for writing exercises.
targetAudience: Beginners who want to start writing
Students who want to improve their writing
Aspiring authors, bloggers and content writers

courses.adiloProjectTitle: Mastering Your Identity : Developing a Tactical Plan for Your Personal Branding Journey
courses.title: Mastering Your Identity: A Tactical Plan for Building Your Personal Brand
courses.subtitle: Define your brand story and value proposition, grow it with content, social media and livestreams, and turn your personal brand into opportunities.
courses.seoTitle: Personal Branding Course: Build Your Brand
courses.seoDescription: Build your personal brand with a tactical plan: brand story, value proposition, content calendar, social media, livestreams and monetisation ideas.
courses.description:
Your personal brand shapes how people see you before they meet you. This course gives you a tactical plan to build it deliberately.

In 20 video lessons you will learn why personal branding matters, the foundations of a strong brand, how to develop a compelling brand story and how to craft your value proposition. You will build authority and engagement with content marketing, plan a content calendar and use social media and livestreams to amplify your brand.

You will also explore how to turn your passion into profit, build a website that supports your brand, establish authority, engage your audience through speaking and keep your brand evolving as you grow.

secondary: how to build a personal brand

learningOutcomes: Explain why a personal brand matters for your career
Develop a compelling personal brand story
Craft a clear value proposition
Plan content with a content marketing calendar
Use social media and livestreams to grow your brand
Build authority and explore ways to monetise your brand
prerequisites: No prior marketing experience is required.
targetAudience: Professionals building their reputation
Freelancers, consultants and creators
Students preparing to stand out in the job market
